statement: Generated Prisma client code in prisma/client/** is excluded from ESLint and is not subject to the lint rules.
In all TypeScript files, code must not declare unused variables, function arguments or caught errors unless their names start with an underscore (_).
In all TypeScript files, code should not use the explicit `any` type.

In React components and hooks in TypeScript files, render code should be pure and should not call impure functions (e.g. Date.now(), Math.random()) during render; the repository lowers this rule to a warning.
In React components and hooks in TypeScript files, code should not call setState synchronously inside a useEffect body; the repository lowers this rule to a warning.
In React components and hooks in TypeScript files, code should not mutate props, state, or values captured by hooks/render (treat them as immutable); the repository lowers this rule to a warning.
